sources.content: Proposal AV-9: synchronous replicas for Altrevo. Motivation: Altrevo replicates writes asynchronously, so a primary failure can lose up to two seconds of committed data. Change: an operator can mark one replica as synchronous; the primary then waits for that replica to confirm each commit before replying to the client. The setting is sync_replica in altrevo.conf and accepts a replica name. Commit latency is expected to rise by about 3 milliseconds within one data center.

Limits: only one synchronous replica is allowed per primary in this version. If the synchronous replica stops responding for 5 seconds, the primary drops back to asynchronous mode and logs a warning, rather than blocking writes. Replicas in a different region are not allowed as synchronous replicas. Rollout: the feature ships in Altrevo 6.2 and is off by default. A later proposal will cover quorum commits across several replicas. Replication traffic uses port 5480.

claims.text: The Altrevo synchronous replica setting is sync_replica in altrevo.conf.
Altrevo allows up to two synchronous replicas per primary in this version.
If the Altrevo synchronous replica stops responding, the primary blocks writes.
Altrevo commit latency is expected to rise by about 3 milliseconds within one data center.
Altrevo replicas in a different region cannot be synchronous replicas.
